summary: Independent integrated-overlay review of 138 completed with changes-requested. The candidate was evaluated against the exact current branch baseline 44e1a64447ba63aa66c3b5653b448101713fb5b7 and the unchanged Q1 persistence/generation contracts. 138 correctly fixes the central Run-137 cases: a valid pending revise no longer requires terminal-only reviewVerdictRef; pending predecessor lineage is checked against an admitted matching-stage changes-requested review; completed revise source-review tuple failure excludes that successor from artifact/verification generation classification. However Q1-RA-007 is still incomplete in two same-invariant edges. First, failed/cancelled revise Runs are legal terminal projections with no actionResult and therefore can never carry reviewVerdictRef, while their context may retain sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict from createRun. The candidate falls through to validateSourceReviewTuple with requiresTuple=false; because sourceReview fields are present, the unchanged shared validator still requires reviewVerdictRef and creates a false immutable-ref-required conflict. Second, the new integrityAdmittedReviseRunIds set is based only on pending predecessor lineage conflicts or completed source-review tupleProblems. Generic immutable Run-result validation failures on the same revise Run (for example a bad non-review context.inputRef or consumedInputRefs target/fingerprint) are added to conflicts but do not disqualify the Run from the eligibility set. Such a pending/completed revise can therefore still open revision-window or superseded semantics after another immutable fact on that successor failed, which remains weaker than the approved two-stage Reader boundary: validate immutable Run facts / review-revise lineage first, then classify generations. The three new focused tests cover valid pending, unadmitted pending and completed missing reviewVerdictRef, but do not cover failed/cancelled revise or a source-lineage-valid revise with another immutable ref conflict. Q1-RA-010 remains resolved and no regression was found in the reviewed RA-006/008/009 boundaries. Delivery Full Test was not authorized or run.

blockingFindings.title: Revise integrity admission is still incomplete across terminal status and all immutable Run facts
blockingFindings.problem: 138 introduces an explicit integrityAdmittedReviseRunIds boundary and correctly distinguishes pending from completed source-review evidence, but the boundary is not yet equivalent to the approved Reader invariant. For failed/cancelled revise Runs, readC1Run projects the persisted sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict from context while the legal RunResultFile has no actionResult/reviewVerdictRef. The candidate still calls validateSourceReviewTuple. Setting requiresTuple=false does not make existing partial evidence optional: the unchanged tuple validator's hasAny branch requires all three fields, so these legal failed/cancelled Runs acquire a false missing-reviewVerdictRef conflict. Separately, non-review inputRef and consumedInputRefs are validated before the source-review check, but those conflicts are only appended to the global conflict list. Pending revise eligibility is granted when lineageConflicts is empty; completed revise eligibility is granted when tupleProblems is empty. Neither decision incorporates immutable-ref problems already found for that same Run. Therefore a revise successor with valid source-review lineage but a corrupted inputRef or consumedInputRefs can remain eligible for generation classification.
blockingFindings.location: 138 payload `src/facts/formal-fact-reader.ts`, especially validateImmutableRunResultRefs around candidate lines 794-860; unchanged `src/persistence/result-ref-adapter.ts` validateSourceReviewTuple; unchanged RunResultFile failed/cancelled projection in serialization/run-persistence.
blockingFindings.impact: The first edge causes a legitimate terminal failure/cancellation to look inconsistent merely because terminal-only evidence is impossible for that status. The second edge permits a successor that already failed another immutable Run-result check to relax predecessor mutable validation by opening revision-window/superseded classification. A global Policy block from the immutable conflict is not sufficient: the approved Reader contract requires generation classification itself to consume only validated immutable/review-revise lineage.
blockingFindings.requiredOutcome: Make revise lineage/admission status-correct for pending, completed, failed and cancelled projections, and ensure generation eligibility represents success of all immutable validation that is applicable to that successor, not only the source-review sub-check. Failed/cancelled revise Runs must not be classified as successors and must not be forced to carry terminal actionResult evidence that their physical schema forbids. Pending revise must retain the Run-137 fix: context-level matching changes-requested predecessor proof without requiring reviewVerdictRef. Completed revise must retain the full immutable source-review tuple proof. Any applicable immutable inputRef/consumedInputRefs/source-review failure on a pending/completed revise must make that Run ineligible to open revision-window or supersession.
acceptance: A legitimate failed revise-* created with sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict and a legal failed result without actionResult does not receive a false missing-reviewVerdictRef conflict and does not participate as a generation successor.
The same holds for a legitimate cancelled revise-*.
A valid pending revise still opens the bounded revision window without terminal reviewVerdictRef.
A completed revise still requires the full reviewVerdictRef source-review tuple.
A pending revise with valid source-review lineage but an invalid optional context.inputRef is not eligible to open revision-window.
A completed revise with a valid source-review tuple but an invalid consumedInputRefs entry is not eligible to supersede its predecessor.
Artifact and verification variants both demonstrate that invalid immutable successor evidence cannot hide predecessor current-byte replacement conflicts.
Existing matching-stage/changes-requested-only behavior and RA-006/008/009/010 remain intact.

resolvedPriorFindings.evidence: The candidate does not modify serialization/action applicability; the 136 top-level runStatus + Action required/forbidden matrix remains the current repository authority.
Review verdict admission still depends on exact-bound admitted review facts; 138 reuses those admittedReviewVerdicts for pending lineage.
138 does not modify the non-Run logical/archive resolver.
138 filters revise-apply successors before verification generation classification without weakening current verificationSummaryRef checks.
138 does not reopen the raw terminal publication boundary.
138 leaves shared effective-set validation ownership unchanged.
138 leaves runtime Run-ID/tag descriptor closure unchanged.
